import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import { resolve } from "node:path";
import type { ToolExecuteContext } from "auggy";

/** Test-owned business adapter evidence. Never imported by application startup. */
export function recordToolEffect(context: ToolExecuteContext, output: unknown): void {
  if (!context.threadId || !context.turnId) throw new Error("Missing tool effect correlation");
  const directory = resolve(import.meta.dir, "../../../data/authoring");
  mkdirSync(directory, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
  const hash = (value: string) => createHash("sha256").update(value).digest("hex");
  appendFileSync(resolve(directory, "tool-effects.jsonl"), JSON.stringify({
    kind: "tool", thread: hash(context.threadId), turn: context.turnId,
    output: hash(JSON.stringify(output)),
  }) + "\n", { mode: 0o600 });
}
